verdict.rationale: A government tax e-service could plausibly offer a conversational or natural-language interface, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents web forms, online accounts, calculators and the EFILE software-transmission channel, with nothing on natural-language command operation. The llms.txt probe also shows no agent-oriented docs are published.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
